verdict.rationale: The agency's own entity search lets users "obtain PDFs of many of the entity filings," which is a limited, document-by-document way to retrieve one's records in a widely readable format. Nothing shows a bulk export of all account or entity data, machine-readable formats, or a documented exit process; probes found no public API or OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: bulk export of all user/entity data, structured machine-readable formats (CSV/JSON), coverage of all filings rather than "many", documented exit/account-closure workflow, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: you can search for details about a business entity and obtain PDFs of many of the entity filings!
